track.name: hate that i made you love me

album.title: HATE THAT I MADE YOU LOVE ME

wiki.summary: “hate that i made you love me“ is the lead single from Ariana Grande's eighth studio album petal, and was released on May 29, 2026. On May 8, 2026, Grande officially announced the song, accompanied by a short message where she described the single as: “one of my favorite songs i’ll ever write.“ On May 18, Ariana Grande shared an Instagram Reel for “hate that i made you love me,” featuring an official snippet of the song’s instrumental, which appeared to be inspired by plant waves. Read more on Last.fm.
wiki.content: “hate that i made you love me“ is the lead single from Ariana Grande's eighth studio album petal, and was released on May 29, 2026. On May 8, 2026, Grande officially announced the song, accompanied by a short message where she described the single as: “one of my favorite songs i’ll ever write.“ On May 18, Ariana Grande shared an Instagram Reel for “hate that i made you love me,” featuring an official snippet of the song’s instrumental, which appeared to be inspired by plant waves. A day later, the Instagram account @brighterdays shared a grid post, with some of the images revealing lyrics from “hate that i made you love me.” Read more on Last.fm.
